title: Spray Rack Anti-Slide Clip for Cabinet Doors
description:
🛠️ Tools & Materials:

BambuLabs PETG HF

Cabinet Door Bumpers (Amazon) – These are the exact ones I use with the clip. (As an Amazon Associate, I earn from qualifying purchases.)

This custom clip was designed to fix a major flaw in the Richelieu spray rack used for painting cabinet doors. The original angled shelves cause doors to slide down and hit the base, risking edge damage—especially when finishing the sides.

This clip snaps securely onto the rack rail and provides a flat, elevated platform wide enough to hold a standard cabinet door bumper. Once installed, the door stays in place, even under vibration or movement.

I designed it in Shapr3D, sliced it with Bambu Studio, and printed it in PETG HF. Tested and confirmed: no more sliding, no more ruined finishes.

title: ToughBuilt 3-Drawer Bin Inserts, Regular + Notched
description:
These custom inserts were designed out of pure necessity. The stock dividers in ToughBuilt 3-drawer bins constantly lifted during transport, letting screws and hardware mix together. That meant dumping everything to sort it again—no thanks.

These printed bins solve that problem by adding snug, secure compartments that keep contents locked in place, even on rough rides. Each version is designed to accommodate dividers without letting them float. Both the regular and front-notched bin shapes are included.

Built for daily abuse in the #ReaperBuild trailer.

• Designed to prevent divider lift and content mixing

• Fits ToughBuilt 3-drawer system (standard + notched bins)

• Divider-ready layout with firm wall support

• Saves time, sanity, and screw-sorting frustration

title: T Track Flip Stop (Requires Hardware)
description:
This 3D-printable T-Track Flip Stop is perfect for woodworkers and makers looking to enhance their T-track setups. The kit includes:

• Flip Stop Body: Designed for easy adjustment and secure locking.

• Flip Arm: Allows for quick and repeatable positioning.

• Knob: Provides ergonomic tightening and adjustment.

• Insert: Ensures compatibility with standard bolts in your T-track.

Required Hardware (not included):

• (1) 1/4-20 Lock Nut

• (1) 1/4-20 Standard Nut

• (1) 1/4-20 Bolt (2” in length)

• (1) 1/4-20 Bolt (1-1/4” to 1-1/2” in length)

Additional Notes:

• The tolerances for this design are fairly tight to ensure a secure fit. However, a STEP file is included for those who may need to make adjustments to accommodate specific T-tracks or hardware.

This simple yet effective setup is ideal for creating precise and repeatable cuts or measurements in your woodworking projects. Print it, assemble it, and take your T-track functionality to the next level!
